_about: One table, three readers: _tooling.read_const (gen_flash.py, gen_vision.py), and
each run every row and require the same verdict: `value` is the integer read, `refused` the
exact refusal, {where} standing for the file. `planted` rows edit the real Vision config.h
(`prepend` text above everything, or `respell` the named constexpr's value) and run gen_vision.py,
gen_flash.py's Vision defaults and vision.test.js on it: no `refused` means each reads what it
reads on the file as committed; `refused` is the start of the refusal. It sits under
canary-local/tests/, which the site and the Lab app leave out. Sweep F369.
